info.description: Source entry for LaserLlama's Alternate Ranger v4.4.4, a from-scratch redesign of the Ranger class.
info.author: laserllama

description.p: "Become the Master of the Wilderness You Were Meant to Be." A complete redesign of the Ranger class by u/laserllama, featuring Knacks, Ranger's Quarry, 10 Fighting Styles, 28 Knacks, and 9 reworked Ranger Conclaves: Beast Master, Deep Stalker, Drake Guard, Fey Wanderer, Hunter, Monster Slayer, Planar Warden, Spellbreaker, and Swarm Keeper.
